parameters.name: base_asset
parameters.description: Base asset identifier ("tu" for TU; on-chain denom for COIN; ISO-4217 currency code for FIAT)

parameters.name: quote_asset
parameters.description: Quote asset identifier (same rules as base_asset)

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Base-asset amount expressed as a base-10 unsigned integer string, in the base asset's base units

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
